title: Qualify observed Ubuntu WSL Linux x64 SDK10 SDK11 host before Math cross-platform consumers
commitMessage: test: qualify Ubuntu WSL net10 net11 SDK host

contribution.summary: Verify the default Ubuntu WSL environment can supply the observed Linux x64 .NET 10 and 11 SDK/runtime baselines.
contribution.value: Read-only Windows-to-WSL host check for Ubuntu 24.04, x86_64, installed SDKs 10.0.401/11.0.100, selected SDK from neutral Linux HOME, and both runtime majors. No WSL configuration or production repository mutation.
debtChanges: RS239 succeeded first-pass attempt 001 for exact temperature conversion and invalid-operation parity under net10 and net11.
The operator supplied evidence of Ubuntu 24.04 WSL with SDK 10.0.401 and 11.0.100; RS240 independently checks host readiness without changing packages or M8 state.

RS240 initial invocation was refused at preselection before attempt allocation: inherited Windows checkout selected a different WSL SDK. This correction checks the neutral Linux home directory without changing the SDK or workflow methodology.
contribution.nextAction: Use a separate isolated Linux Math source consumer in WSL and then qualify immutable NuGet binary consumers before framework migration decisions.
